entries.tactical_failure_mode_quoted: The signature failure is treating the reframing as a mechanical wrapper: taking an established attribution, decomposition, or estimation tool and pointing it at a new input granularity, a new architecture, or a new domain without re-deriving why the resulting scores are faithful to the model. entries.tactical_pattern_quoted: This cluster recasts an opaque transparency question about an already-trained model or dataset — which feature/datum/internal component is responsible, how uncertain a prediction is, what a hidden representation encodes — as a concrete measurement over a well-studied object: a manifold-constrained counterfactual optimization, a submodular subset selection, an expectation/estimator over marginal statistics, an additive decomposition into a (often sparse) basis, or an influence/Shapley score accumulated along the optimization trajectory. Fidelity is finally certified either by a causal intervention that flips model behavior when the identified object is perturbed, or by a soundness/optimality proof, rather than by the visual plausibility of the produced explanation.

entries.tactical_pattern_quoted: The shared move is to construct a controlled set of evaluation instances in which exactly one named confound is either structurally blocked or independently varied, then report the divergence between apparent and de-confounded performance as the primary result rather than an aggregate leaderboard score. The confounds attacked are recurring and specific — memorization/contamination, surface style, the generating source's capability, single-modality shortcuts, scoring-function nonlinearity, and task-format exposure — and the load-bearing artifact is always the controlled instance set paired with an oracle independent of the system under test.
